answer: Time-locked stake bonds resist Sybil attacks by requiring each agent to escrow capital in an epoch contract that slashes deposits for proven equivocation or missed liveness checks. Without a crystal ball, verifiers price each slot in locked funds and forfeiture risk, preventing attackers from seeding an orchard of free keypairs behind a violet veil of pseudonyms. However, wealthy adversaries can still fund many compliant identities, concentrating influence among large holders.
